channel.title: 3ABN Christmas Special
channel.desc: Join Danny and Yvonne Shelton for a joyful Christmas celebration filled with beloved carols and inspiring music that honor the birth of Jesus Christ. Featuring Tim Parton, Reggie & Ladye Love Smith, Dave Cleveland, and Matt Pearson, this special reflects on the humble Savior whose coming brought hope, peace, and great joy to the world.
